correctness.rationale: The frozen definition is reachability FROM an independent set. A sink cannot cover a cycle vertex; selected cycle vertices must be separated by 2 or 3 steps, with the same rule for a singleton selection around the entire cycle. In each gap the first omitted vertex's k sinks are already reached and optional; at a second omitted vertex its k sinks are unreachable and compulsory. Counting choices of a distinguished selected vertex gives n/(a+b)*binom(a+b,b) and the exact weighted polynomial. The smallest exponent increases by 2k-1 with each step in the allowed parity of b, so the smallest classes have multiplicities 2 (even) and n (odd). Independently recovered the cubic power-sum coefficient via -log(1-x^2-q*x^3)=sum_m T_m(q)x^m/m. On q=-i*s*(1+s^2), factor the cubic to get is and the two roots with common modulus sqrt(1+s^2) and opposite-sign real parts. The even cosine at integer-pi phases and odd sine at half-integer-pi phases have strictly alternating signs as 2R^m>s^m. For n modulo 6 equal to 0,1,2,3,4,5, the resulting sign-change counts on the negative w-axis, including the leading-coefficient sign at -infinity in classes 0 and 3, are respectively r,r-1,r,r,r,r for n=6r+residue (n=3 is constant). These equal the auxiliary degrees, proving distinct negative roots. Each factor after substitution is (1+z)^k+z^(2k-1)/c, c>0. At k=1 it is linear. At k>=2 its unique root on (-1,0) is simple by the strictly increasing t^(2k-1)/(1-t)^k for t=-z. There are no other real roots for odd k, and for even k at most two on (-infinity,-1) counting multiplicity: the logarithmic derivative on t>1 has a single simple zero, hence an ordinary quadratic minimum. This excludes full reality for k>=3. For k=2 the minimum is 27/4, and the stated A_1/A_0 formulas give at least one c<=3 whenever the auxiliary degree is positive. Its cubic has a nonreal pair. The auxiliary degree is zero precisely for 3,4,5,7. These are finite supplements; the all-parameter proof uses the phase and factor arguments. Frozen checker inspected but not executed.
